about: Role cards that are also built as Claude Code subagent files. The role card stays the source: edit it, then rebuild with scripts/build_agents.py. Pick a role only when it is useful on its own, outside a coordinated team.

agents.name: agency-loop-judge
agents.why: Every judged loop dispatches it; Haiku is the first judge, and a Sonnet confirmer is the same agent with the model overridden

agents.name: agency-prose-humanizer
agents.why: A final prose pass is asked for on its own and is the Research division's prose finish; it edits text, and runs prose_check.py to prove protected spans survived

agents.name: agency-capability-curator
agents.why: Adoption decisions on a new skill or tool come up outside any team

agents.name: agency-document-extraction-reviewer
agents.why: Hard scans and tables need it in any project, with judgement on what is unreadable

agents.name: agency-fieldbook-accuracy-verifier
agents.why: A claim trace of an existing Fieldbook is often asked for without a rebuild; verifiers stay on a larger model

agents.name: agency-research-scout
agents.why: Starts every research job and often closes it from the knowledge base alone

agents.name: agency-research-web-researcher
agents.why: The default fan-out worker; search and fetch workers run on Haiku

agents.name: agency-research-primary-artifact-hunter
agents.why: Every research round runs it, and agents do not look for manuals unless told

agents.name: agency-research-history-transcript-researcher
agents.why: Transcripts and forum history need their own tools and rules

agents.name: agency-research-recent-signal-researcher
agents.why: Takes over what last30days did, on free sources only, from any harness

agents.name: agency-research-source-clerk
agents.why: An independent credibility score keeps researchers from rating their own sources

agents.name: agency-research-claim-verifier
agents.why: The verification pass must run on a different model from the compiler

agents.name: agency-media-runtime-comfyui
agents.why: Engine updates and server, node or workflow faults come up outside a planned job, and every ComfyUI runtime without its own specialist uses it; Haiku writes sheets, and a diagnosis reruns it with the model set to sonnet

agents.name: agency-media-runtime-minimax-h3
agents.why: H3 readiness, limits and slow-render questions are asked on their own, before any team forms; Haiku writes sheets, and a diagnosis reruns it with the model set to sonnet

agents.name: agency-media-runtime-krea
agents.why: Whether a Krea card or LoRA has actually run here is a common standalone question; Haiku writes sheets, and a diagnosis reruns it with the model set to sonnet

agents.name: agency-media-runtime-stable-audio
agents.why: SA3 checkpoint, length and batch questions come up for loop packs and SFX outside a full team; Haiku writes sheets, and a diagnosis reruns it with the model set to sonnet

agents.name: agency-mediakit-curator
agents.why: Every Agency run that made visual or audio files closes with it; it looks at each file and copies keepers into the project's .mediakit through mediakit.py, so it needs no Edit or Write

agents.name: agency-usage-steward
agents.why: Drafts the handoff when usage_gate.py returns wrap-up or stop, or sets handoff_now, from the run's usage log, state and record; the coordinator reads the meter and runs the gate itself

agents.name: agency-web-browser
agents.why: Any team can hand it pages WebFetch cannot read; it climbs the archive, and with the owner's OK for the run uses browse.py over agent-browser for plain or rendered reads and screenshots; it never has the app's browser pane
